storyboard.title: Keep your flow
storyboard.voice: Dictation should fit the way you work.
storyboard.action: Browser, Ghostty and Herdr share a real Omarchy desktop. The film starts in an actual working environment.
storyboard.motion: Keep the desktop still for one beat, then introduce the recorder. Real VM capture; no invented shell.

storyboard.title: Meet Mluva
storyboard.voice: Meet Mluva, most delightful dictation app for Omarchy.
storyboard.action: Original unfolding-thought mark, custom JetBrains Mono wordmark and one clear promise.
storyboard.motion: Calm lockup reveal over the licensed water loop. Reuse the Brand masters.

storyboard.title: Choose providers
storyboard.action: Welcome presents speech and rewrite provider/model choices. Continue into the app.
storyboard.motion: Show first-run setup, then the Providers route. Settings fills the window.

storyboard.title: F9. Talk. F9. Paste.
storyboard.action: Press F9 to start and stop. Text wraps continuously, then arrives in the previously focused editor.
storyboard.motion: Automatic pasting enabled. Show exact source text and the real target; no sentence-by-sentence line breaks.

storyboard.title: Float, tile, open
storyboard.voice: Omarchy moves like water. Tile it, or let it float.
storyboard.action: Move the same Mluva window between floating and tiled states; keep surrounding apps filled.
storyboard.motion: Use real Omarchy window borders and Super+T. Do not substitute an invented desktop.

storyboard.title: Edit and find an action
storyboard.voice: Done talking? Edit it, polish it, rewrite it.
storyboard.action: Open Ctrl+P, choose Polish text, show the changed words, then return to the finished result.
storyboard.motion: Speed up the result animation. Speech arrives immediately at full opacity; existing-word corrections may settle upward by 3 px in 180 ms. Native GTK replaces them immediately.

storyboard.title: Return to a note
storyboard.action: Search history and return to the same note, with its original and revisions retained.
storyboard.motion: Keep the selected note legible. No new feature claim.

storyboard.title: Your desktop, your palette
storyboard.voice: Your desktop, your palette. Any Omarchy theme, automatically.
storyboard.action: The current Omarchy theme supplies the palette. Demonstrate three examples, including actual window border changes.
storyboard.motion: Three shown examples are not a support limit. Use real captures plus shared semantic theme modes.

storyboard.title: Live rewrite
storyboard.voice: Try Live rewrite. Keep speaking as your text takes shape.
storyboard.action: Dictate a structured note. Preserve the source and update only changed words in the Markdown draft.
storyboard.motion: Live rewrite is experimental. No email example. Continuous source wrapping; collapse either pane without data loss.

storyboard.title: Give the task a shape
storyboard.voice: Or build a task spec, with questions for what’s still missing.
storyboard.action: Keep the user's answer visible while the answered question retires and the next useful question appears.
storyboard.motion: Animate question replacement and append the confirmed requirement. Never erase the answer.

storyboard.title: A little more delight
storyboard.voice: A little more delight every day.
storyboard.action: Return to the same Mluva mark and custom JetBrains Mono wordmark. Hold the closing phrase and repository.
storyboard.motion: Use the shared water background. Keep the final lockup readable for the last beat.

motions.name: Breathing light / Blender study
motions.boundary: All 102 alpha poses are shown one at a time. Film uses the continuous 30 fps WebM; the app uses a lightweight harmonic contour.
102 Blender poses reproduce one 3.4-second breath; two cycles in the native Figma timeline.
motions.name: Breathing / Circular endpoints
Desktop / Float to tile
motions.boundary: Native Figma crossfade between real captured endpoints. The separate MP4 contains actual compositor movement.

motions.name: Background / Water loop
motions.boundary: Editable camera motion on a full-resolution water poster. Use the supplied licensed MP4 for moving ripples.

motions.name: Recorder / Empty to overflow
motions.boundary: Authored constant-cadence example. Production app estimates recent speech rate; timing is not a latency claim.

motions.name: Theme / Palette change
motions.boundary: Editorial wipes between real capture palettes including borders. Three examples do not limit theme support.

motions.name: Brand / Title reveal
motions.boundary: Original abstract thought mark and custom JetBrains Mono outlined wordmark.

motions.name: Grilling / Answer and advance
motions.boundary: Experimental Grilling example; retained answer and confirmed requirement persist.

motions.name: Rewrite / Changed words
motions.boundary: An explicit spoken Tuesday-to-Wednesday correction. Local previous/current diff; no provider patch protocol.

examples.polished: Could we reschedule the review for Tuesday? I’ll send the draft tomorrow.
examples.corrected: Could we move the review to Wednesday? I’ll send the draft tomorrow.

editing.masters: Change component masters and exposed properties. Motion-local copies remain separate for editable keyframes.
editing.theme: Modes recolor semantic vector/text bindings; runtime capture pixels do not recolor.
editing.opacity: Figma uses percent values; source tokens also retain application-scale alpha.
editing.canvas: reflow-canvas.mjs, one invocation per page; dry-run first.
editing.motion: retime-motion.mjs refreshes all 395 native tracks across both motion pages; dry-run first. Dedicated loop durations follow their period; editorial studies retain end holds and only extend.
editing.wordmark: Outlined custom artwork; editable app/film text uses JetBrains Mono.
editing.latestStudy: Logo Study: ten unselected directions and twenty raster masters. Preserve original PNGs. Keep wordmark aspect ratios when resizing; Figma crops normalize optical size.

media.water: Licensed 10 s 1080p / 24 fps MP4 supplied in private production handoff.
media.breath: 3.4 s, 384×384, 30 fps alpha WebM; 102 native Figma poses; circular collapsed/expanded endpoints. The source is an art-directed metaball surface.
media.desktop: 8 s 2560×1440 / 30 fps actual Omarchy transition supplied in production handoff.
